questions.question: When Saul began preaching about Jesus in the synagogues of Damascus, what did he declare about Jesus?

answers.text: He is the Son of God

questions.question: When Jews in Damascus watched the city gates to kill Saul, how did his disciples help him escape?

answers.text: Lowered him in a basket through a window
Hid him in a merchant's cart
Dressed him as a Roman soldier

questions.question: When Saul came to Jerusalem and tried to join the disciples there, how did they respond to him?

answers.text: They were all afraid of him
